instruction: Studio photograph, medium shot. Three cheerleaders are featured in a close lineup against a white studio background. In the center is the short black-haired woman (R4), flanked by the purple-haired woman (R7) on her left and the dark brown-haired woman (R9) on her right. The curly-haired woman (R1) and the long dark-haired woman (R6) are partially visible on the outer edges. They wear white 'Warsaw Mets' t-shirts and hold metallic orange pom-poms at their hips, looking directly at the camera with serious expressions. Bright studio lighting with a subtle cool undertone illuminates the scene.
